verdict.rationale: Medusa maintains machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specs for both its Store and Admin REST APIs, so there is a documented programmatic surface covering the admin side that the dashboard manages. However, no evidence explicitly states that the Admin API matches everything the admin UI can do. The probe showing OpenAPI 404s at docs paths only concerns discovery locations and does not contradict this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the Admin API has full parity with the admin dashboard (e.g., that the dashboard is built entirely on the public API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of that parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Medusa maintains complete machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 specifications for the Store (and Admin) REST APIs in the medusajs/medusa repository; they power the docs.medusajs.com/api reference.
